rationale: The question asks whether the world population grew every year from 2016 to 2025. key_conditions: 1. No global event (e.g., pandemic, war) caused a significant rise in deaths. 2. No major global decline in fertility rates occurred. 3. Annual UN population data confirms continuous growth from 2016 to 2025. 4. No retroactive adjustments to UN data invalidate the observed growth.
